about: The overnight run (plan Wave 2, W2.6), on Krish's two home computers, with no Claude on a timer: Codex and scripts only. His Titles press starts it: the recordings pass on each computer (scripts/recordings-upload.ps1, the windowless task already polling the engine) asks scripts/overnight/overnight.py due, and starts the run with no window. The primary computer makes the long cuts and builds the Monday board; the standby makes the shorts. Which computer is which is the setting MINDMAKE_OVERNIGHT_ROLE (primary or standby) on each. Steps are argument lists; a step set to null is not wired, and the run says so on the board instead of guessing.

repair.why: Repairs render at reduced scale and the full-scale render runs once, at the end, after a fresh Critic passes the cut (W2.6, Speed and benchmark).

produce.note: quick-edit makes a cut at full size only (make.py has no scale), so on this route every repair render is full size until it takes one; the ve shadow route (W2.7) takes ve render --scale.

critic.note: A fresh Codex task each round (codex exec --sandbox read-only), shown contact sheets of the cut and its maker's rejection floor; it returns findings only and critic_run.py writes the rest of the verdict. The run uses it only once critic-calibrated.json is recorded.

critic_note: The Critic route is steps.critic (scripts/overnight/critic_run.py judge): a fresh Codex task under config/codex-profile.json with a read-only card per round. The run calls it only once the primary computer has calibrated it (critic_run.py cases, then critic.py calibrate ... --record; config/critic-calibration.json). Until a calibration record is there, a cut is made and shown on the board as not judged by a calibrated Critic; it is never called passed.

repair_round.note: When the board holds a cut a repair could mend, the primary starts one bounded repair round in GitHub Actions (gh workflow run), if gh is signed in on it; otherwise the run record says it is wanted and his press on the board or Control Center starts it.
